summary: Iter 28: Excel template data-validations + 'Open in Google Sheets' workflow tested end-to-end. 13/13 backend tests passed and the full frontend flow (3 cards, 3 buttons each, CSV download + new tab to docs.google.com/spreadsheets/create) works correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: uploads.py line 132: DataValidation formula1 wraps the range in '=' (formula1=f"={ref_range}"). Excel/openpyxl accepts both but Google Sheets sometimes does not honour list validations from a named range — acceptable here since the dropdown is only authoritative when the file is opened in Excel.

_read_excel hint-skip relies on the first cell starting with 'e.g.'. Students template hints[4] is 'M / F / Other' (no e.g. prefix) — if a user reorders columns so the gender hint becomes column A, the hint row would not be skipped. Low-risk but worth noting.
upload_students: count_documents-based UID generation (`STU-{count+1}`) is race-prone for concurrent uploads; consider an atomic counter.
seed_data_creation: 1 holiday created via test (TEST_iter28_holiday, 2099-12-25) — visible on dashboard 'Upcoming holidays' panel.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter28_uploads.xml is the regression baseline. xlsx tests use openpyxl to inspect data_validations.dataValidation, wb.sheetnames, and reference rows. Frontend Sheets-button test captures new tabs via page.context.on('page', ...) — Google redirects to accounts.google.com/v3/signin but URL contains docs.google.com/spreadsheets in the continue= param so we match on 'docs.google.com' substring after page settles.

backend: GET /api/uploads/template/students — Upload+References sheets, DataValidation on class_id (col B) pointing to References sheet, Grade 5 + Grade 6 listed
GET /api/uploads/template/attendance — DVs on student_uid (A) + status (C), 8 students STU-00001..STU-00008 + 6 statuses listed
GET /api/uploads/template/marks — 3 DVs (cols A/B/C), references include all 8 students
GET /api/uploads/template/holidays — DV on type column, 4 holiday types listed
GET /api/uploads/template-csv/{kind} for all 4 kinds: 200, text/csv, headers+hint row
Upload fresh xlsx (headers + hint only) → inserted=0, errors=0 (hint row skipped via 'e.g.' check)
Upload xlsx with hint row + 1 real holiday row → inserted=1, errors=0
frontend: /school/uploads loads cards for Students, Attendance, Holidays
Each card shows 3 buttons in order: download-{kind}-template → open-sheets-{kind} → upload-{kind}-input-label

Clicking 'Open in Google Sheets' triggers CSV download (students_template.csv / holidays_template.csv) AND opens new tab → https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/create (redirects to Google sign-in, target URL preserved)
Success toast appears: 'CSV downloaded · In the new Sheets tab: File → Import → Upload → pick the file'
'Download Excel template' button correctly downloads .xlsx file
